y-m-03-01.title: Umugqa Ofanayo Wamabhathini, Amaqembu Ahlukene Amabhathini Amakhulu
y-m-03-01.topic: Izindinganiso zokuhlela: ukunquma amagama anikeza umphumela ofanayo wawo wonke umuntu
y-m-03-01.goal: Qonda ukuthi ukuhlela ngegama elinjengelithi 'enkulu,' umngcele walo ongacacile, kungaba nemiphumela ehlukile kubantu abahlukile, bese wenza futhi usho indinganiso enikeza umphumela ofanayo noma ngubani ohlela.
y-m-03-01.material:
Amabhathini angu-8 ahlelwe emugqeni owodwa kusuka encane kakhulu kuya kunkulu kakhulu. Kusuka kwesobunxele aqanjwe ngo-가, 나, 다, 라, 마, 바, 사, no-아. Amabhathini onke anombala nomumo ofanayo futhi ahluka kuphela ngosayizi.
UMina uqoqe 라, 마, 바, 사, no-아 (amabhathini angu-5) njengo-'amabhathini amakhulu'. UHajun uqoqe 마, 바, 사, no-아 (amabhathini angu-4) njengo-'amabhathini amakhulu'. Bobabili babheke umugqa ofanayo wamabhathini, futhi bobabili bahlela ngegama elithi 'ibhathini enkulu'.
y-m-03-01.thinking.1: Nquma ukuthi yini enye edingekayo ukuze kutholwe umphumela ofanayo
y-m-03-01.s.s1.prompt: Yisiphi isizathu esifaneleke kakhulu sokuthi amabhathini amakhulu aqoqwe ngabantu ababili ahlukile?
y-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala amabhathini amakhulu aqoqwe ngabantu ababili eceleni komunye nomunye, bese uthola ukuthi yiwaphi amabhathini ahlukile.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ulifaka yini lelo bhathini 'emabhathini amakhulu' noma cha, futhi uma ubunquma, ubuzobheka ini ukuze unqume.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.o.a: UMina unamehlo angcono kunoHajun, ngakho ukuqoqa kukaMina kunembile kakhulu
y-m-03-01.s.s1.r.a: Ukubone njengodaba lokubona kahle noma kabi. Bobabili babheke umugqa ofanayo baqoqa besebenzisa igama elithi 'enkulu', ngakho umehluko kwakuyindawo lapho umugqa wegama ulele khona.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.o.b: Babale inombolo ngephutha, ngakho uma bebala futhi imiphumela yabantu ababili izofana
y-m-03-01.s.s1.r.b: Ukubone njengephutha lokubala. Umehluko phakathi kuka-5 no-4 ungase ube ngenxa yephutha lokubala, kodwa ungase ube nangenxa yokuthi bahluke endaweni yokuqala ukubiza ibhathini 'ibhathini enkulu'.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.o.c: UHajun wayengazi incazelo ye-'enkulu', ngakho nguHajun kuphela ongalungile futhi uMina ulungile
y-m-03-01.s.s1.r.c: Ukubone njengomuntu oyedwa kuphela ongalungile. Bobabili baqoqa ngokungaguquki ngendinganiso yabo.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.o.d: Akunqunywa ngegama kuphela ukuthi iyiphi ibhathini 'enkulu' eqala kuyo, ngakho bahlukanise umugqa ngokuhlukile
y-m-03-01.s.s1.r.d: Uqondise ukunaka kwakho endaweni lapho igama elithi 'enkulu' lihlukana khona. Lena yinkolelo eyahlola umngcele wegama okuyindinganiso.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.explain: Ngegama elinjengelithi 'enkulu' kuphela, lapho abantu bengadweba umugqa ngokuhlukile, kunzima ukuthola umphumela ofanayo. UMina wabona amabhathini kusuka ku-라 njengo-'amabhathini amakhulu', futhi uHajun wabona amabhathini kusuka ku-마 njengo-'amakhulu'. Bobabili bahlela ngokungaguquki ngendinganiso yabo.
y-m-03-01.s.s2.prompt: Ukuze abantu ababili bathole umphumela ofanayo kusukela manje, yini okumele inqunywe kuqala?
y-m-03-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khomba futhi indawo lapho uMina noHajun bahlela ngokuhlukile khona.
y-m-03-01.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi abantu ababili badinga ukuvumelana ngani ukuze banqume ngendlela efanayo ncamashi ukuthi balibeke kuyiphi uhlangothi kuleyo ndawo.
y-m-03-01.s.s2.o.a: Yenza abantu ababili banqume ngendlela efanayo ukuthi iyiphi ibhathini okumele ibalwe ngokuthi 'ibhathini enkulu' kusukela kuyo
y-m-03-01.s.s2.r.a: Uqondise ukunaka kwakho endaweni lapho umugqa wokuhlukanisa ukhona. Ukhethe okudingekayo ukwenza indinganiso ibe munye.
y-m-03-01.s.s2.o.b: Esikhundleni se-'ibhathini enkulu', yibize ngegama eliqinile elinjengelithi 'ibhathini enkulu kakhulu'
y-m-03-01.s.s2.r.b: Abantu bangabona ngokuhlukile ukuthi 'enkulu kakhulu' iqala kuphi. Uma ushintsha igama kuphela, umngcele awukanqunywa.
y-m-03-01.s.s2.o.c: Qhathanisa imiphumela abantu ababili abayiqoqile bese ulandela leyo enenani elikhulu
y-m-03-01.s.s2.r.c: Lo mugqa unqunywa ube umphumela owodwa, kodwa kweminye imigqa yamabhathini ingahluka futhi. Ayinquli incazelo ye-'enkulu'.
y-m-03-01.s.s2.o.d: Umuntu oyedwa uqoqa kuqala futhi omunye uqoqa ulandela
y-m-03-01.s.s2.r.d: Ucabange ngokulandelana kokuqoqa. Uma uqoqa ulandela, ukopa nje umugqa womuntu oyedwa, futhi indinganiso ayinqunyiwe.
y-m-03-01.s.s2.explain: Uma sekunqunywe ukuthi iyiphi ibhathini eqala ukubalwa njengebhathini enkulu, umugqa wokuhlukanisa unqunywa ube munye. Kunezindlela eziningi zokunquma (isibonelo, kusuka ebhathini 라, noma enkulu kunebhathini maphakathi).

y-m-03-01.s.s3.hint.1: Funda amagama akho kumngani bese ucabanga ukuthi amabhathini afanayo ayavela yini.
y-m-03-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngamagama owanqumile, ingabe kunqunywa kube munye ukuthi yiwaphi amabhathini ayizinkulu?
y-m-03-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uma uMina noHajun befunda amagama ami, ingabe bangakhetha amabhathini afanayo?
y-m-03-01.s.s3.model.0: Uma unquma ukuthi amabhathini kusuka ku-라 ayinkulu, umphumela ofanayo uyaphuma noma ngubani ohlela.
y-m-03-01.s.s3.model.1: Uma usho ukuthi 'inkulu kunebhathini 마', uMina noHajun bazohlela ngendlela efanayo ncamashi.
y-m-03-01.s.s3.model.2: Sho ukuthi ibhathini inkulu uma inkulu kunebhathini maphakathi. Indawo yokusika inqunyiwe, ngakho wonke umuntu uthola umphumela ofanayo.
y-m-03-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Uma umugqa unamabhathini amabili maphakathi, udinga ukunquma kanye futhi, njengo-'elinye lesobunxele lamabhathini amabili maphakathi'.
y-m-03-01.s.s3.model.3: Uma ubiza ibhathini engenani eliphindwe okungenani kabili elibhathini encane kakhulu ngokuthi ibhathini enkulu futhi uqoqa ngokukala ngomthetho, umphumela ofanayo uyaphuma noma ngubani oqoqayo.

y-m-03-02.title: Ngihlukanise ngaba ngamabhokisi amabili, kodwa amakhadi anyukile
y-m-03-02.goal: Qonda ukuthi uma amagama amabhokisi ahlelwe ayafana noma amanye amakhadi engena kunalitho ibhokisi, umphumela obaliwe ungahluka kusamba sonke, bese ulungisa ukuhlela kube ngukuthi ikhadi ngalinye lingena endaweni eyodwa kuphela.
y-m-03-02.material:
Kunamakhadi angu-9 sekukonke. Amagama amakhadi namanani amakhadi anjengalokhu.
[Amakhadi] Indingilizi ebomvu amakhadi angu-3 / Indingilizi eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka amakhadi angu-2 / Unxantathu obomvu amakhadi angu-2 / Unxantathu oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka amakhadi angu-2 (amakhadi angu-9 sekukonke)
USeoa wenze amabhokisi amabili. Elilodwa 'libhokisi lamakhadi abomvu' kanti elinye 'libhokisi lamakhadi ezindingilizi'. Ubheke amakhadi ngalinye elilodwa wafaka ikhadi ngalinye elifanelana nebhokisi kuleli bhokisi. Amakhadi angafanelani nelilodwa lamabhokisi ashiywa etafuleni.

y-m-03-02.s.s1.line.4: Ngihlukanise ngaba ngamabhokisi amabili ngaphandle kokushiya lutho, ngakho ukuhlela kwenziwe kahle.
y-m-03-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3: izindingilizi ezibomvu ezingu-3 zingena kokubili 'ebhokisini lamakhadi abomvu' 'nebhokisini lamakhadi ezindingilizi', ngakho zabalwa kabili. Ngakho u-10, isamba sika-5 no-5, akulona inani lamakhadi. Umugqa 4: ukwanda kuka-10 owabalwa emabhokisini kungenxa yokubala amakhadi afanayo kabili. Akukhona ukuthi amakhadi angu-9 abalwa ekuqaleni ayeyiphutha. Umugqa 5: onxantathu oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka abangu-2 abakwazi ukungena kunalitho ibhokisi, ngakho bashiywa etafuleni. Ngakho 'ngaphandle kokushiya lutho' nakho akulungile. Imigqa 1 no-2 isho umphumela obaliwe njengoba unjalo, ngakho ilungile.

y-m-03-02.s.s2.o.e: Faka amakhadi angu-3 afanayo kuphela ebhokisini lamakhadi abomvu

Ngendinganiso yomumo kungamadingilizi angu-5 nonxantathu abangu-4, futhi ngendinganiso yombala kubomvu abangu-5 nabaluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka abangu-4. Isamba singamakhadi angu-9 kokubili.

y-m-03-03.title: Ingabe ithebula leqembu elilodwa lingakhuluma ngekilasi lonke?

y-m-03-08.s.s2.o.b: Isu lezilwane lijabulisa kakhulu kunepaki yokuzijabulisa
y-m-03-08.s.s2.r.b: Uphendule u-'abantu abaningi bakukhethile' waba u-'kuyajabulisa'. Ithebula likutshela kuphela inani labantu abakhethile.
y-m-03-08.s.s2.o.c: Abangane abaningi bakhethe isu lezilwane kunabakhethe imnyuziyamu
y-m-03-08.s.s2.r.c: Uqhathanise izinombolo ezimbili ethebuleni ngqo futhi washo.
y-m-03-08.s.s2.o.d: Abangane abakhethe imnyuziyamu abakaze baye kwezinye izindawo
y-m-03-08.s.s2.r.d: Wenze isipiliyoni esingekho ethebuleni. Ithebula likutshela kuphela izindawo abafuna ukuya kuzo.
y-m-03-08.s.s2.explain: Ithebula likutshela kuphela u-'bangaki abafundi abakhethe yiphi indawo'. Isamu lingabafundi abangu-12, ngakho bonke bakhethe eyodwa yezindawo ezintathu, futhi ungasho nokuthi isu lezilwane linabaningi kunemnyuziyamu. Ukujabula noma isipiliyoni akunakwaziwa ngethebula.
